parameters.query:
WITH stale_executions AS (
  UPDATE workflow_execution_logs
     SET status = 'failed',
         completed_at = now(),
         summary = CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(summary, '') = '' THEN 'Marcada como fallida: no se recibió callback dentro del plazo.'
           ELSE summary || ' · Marcada como fallida: no se recibió callback dentro del plazo.'
         END,
         details = COALESCE(details, '{}'::jsonb) ||
           jsonb_build_object('stale_marked_at', now(), 'stale_reason', 'callback_timeout')
   WHERE status = 'running'
     AND started_at < now() - make_interval(hours => $1::int)
  RETURNING id
), stale_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM stale_executions
), expected(job_type) AS (
  VALUES ('nvd'), ('ct_log'), ('tls_expiry'), ('shodan'), ('scorecard_refresh_all'), ('cleanup_archive')
), latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (job_type) job_type, last_run, status
  FROM monitoring_jobs
  ORDER BY job_type, last_run DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
)
SELECT e.job_type, latest.last_run, latest.status, stale_count.count AS stale_executions
FROM expected e
CROSS JOIN stale_count
LEFT JOIN latest USING (job_type)
ORDER BY e.job_type;
